fieldNotes.truckGate: Chain-link perimeter fencing with sliding/rolling gates across the truck access road into the fenced mill yard - confirmed in Street View (2023). Controlled but no staffed booth seen.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No distinct staffed guard booth visible in satellite or Street View; flagged uncertain. Set false.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: True by inference - there is a controlled gated truck entrance but no visible staffed guard shack, implying remote/kiosk check-in.
fieldNotes.railServed: Active rail spur runs through the property alongside the drop yards - clearly visible in satellite and Street View.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Multi-building manufacturing campus: process/paper-machine buildings, a converting warehouse, an admin building, plus structures split across both sides of the elevated highway.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Large drop yards north and south of the highway, ~70 trailers visible in angled rows; banded 25-50 for marked drop stalls.
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: ~14 doors estimated on the converting/warehouse building face; some building faces obscured by process equipment - honest estimate.
fieldNotes.truckGateCount: At least 2 controlled entry points (north mill yard and south trailer yard); flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale clearly visible from overhead; flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Urban - the mill sits inside the City of Mobile within a dense riverside industrial corridor.
